test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: What is the name of the Operation under which India has carried out precision strikes on terrorist camps in Pakistan and Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Operation Sindoor.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Indian Armed Forces carried out precision strikes under 'Operation Sindoor' targeting terrorist camps in Pakistan and PoJK.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Operation Sindoor was launched as a response to the Pahalgam terrorist attack.**
 
• **A total of 9 terrorist sites were targeted in Pakistan and PoJK.**
 
• **The strikes were precise, measured, and non-escalatory in nature.**
 
• **No Pakistani military installations were attacked, showing India’s restraint.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Operation Trident**__

 __
 
• Naval operation launched during the Indo-Pak war of 1971.
 
• Focused on attacking Karachi harbour.
 
 
 
• **Operation Shakti**__
 __
 
• India's nuclear tests conducted in May 1998.
 
• Also known as Pokhran-II tests.
 
 
 
• **Operation Vijay**__
 
 
• Codename for the 1999 Kargil War operation.
 
• India recaptured strategic peaks from Pakistani intruders.
